findings.clock_order: run.tcl reads the selected 8 ns or 10 ns XDC before synth_design, starts from fresh RTL, and records the exact default synthesis command. No checkpoint is read.
findings.source_qualification: The code rebuilds the 18 alias source order from frozen V115 origins, expects 17 SV files plus the ROM include, hashes snapshots, and requires focused/inherited/peer proof selectors and the successful integrated LIVE parent selector with source and artifact pin verification.
findings.functional_gate: Spatial receipt must pass semantic successful-event comparison, independently exact canonical artifacts, two seeds, 44 case profiles and 42 directed checks, retained original oracles, and actual V97 transport proof. Focused receipts require assertions, strict warnings and -Werror.
findings.schedule_budget: Dispatch records are globally counted under experiments/python-gamebub-v118: max two distinct source compositions, four initial source/clock trials, two initial trials per clock, and two positive-repeat slots total with at most one per clock. A serialized root grant is still needed to avoid concurrent budget-check races.
findings.resource_gate: Preflight requires 8 GiB available, PSI full avg10 below 1 and combined used fraction below .85; Docker caps each native run at 2 CPUs, 8 GiB memory and 8 GiB memory+swap. Runtime stop checks cover available RAM, PSI and combined use.
findings.license: The license path is checked for existence, mounted read-only, and passed through the Vivado environment. The Python runner does not read or copy its contents and declares license_contents_logged false. Raw Vivado stdout is retained; add a post-run check or log filter if vendor license diagnostics must be guaranteed absent.
findings.route_parser: Route summary uses WNS/TNS/setup failures, WHS/THS/hold failures and WPWS/TPWS/pulse failures. Gate checks the exact clock period/waveform, zero setup/hold/pulse failures, no clock/unconstrained internal endpoints/loops/latches/multiple clocks, and fully routed nets with zero routing errors.
findings.parser_control_replay: Replayed parser on the retained V117 C route reports (read-only): it recognized both 8 ns/10 ns clocks and exact WNS values (-1.679/-0.317 ns), and correctly left both controls unqualified with zero routing errors.
findings.old_cycle_schema: The candidate spatial receipt gate explicitly requires B_all_stdout_records_events_and_cycles_exact=false and baseline_successful_event_semantics_exact=true. The original exact-cycle checker stays frozen; no native gate silently requires old cycle equality.
findings.live_guard_shape: The required LIVE selector and receipt use the path/sha256 wrapper emitted by live_guard/qualify.py; AREA resolves from an integrated-study/prepared/<name>/preflight.json parent path as intended. Native checks the V118 status, actual_RTL_run, pinned artifacts, four runs, and all 18 candidate source digests.
findings.standalone_auditor: audit_native.py imports the native driver without bytecode, sets AREA to the integrated-study directory from the preflight path correctly, then re-runs qualify() and global budget checks. It does not launch Vivado.
findings.audit_xdc_gap: audit_native.py checks the copied clock text and disallows a short list of timing commands, but does not hash component.xdc against the canonical selected clock file in fpga/experiments/cu66-v118-flow. Native preparation itself copies the canonical file, but an independent preflight should compare copied XDC bytes to that canonical file to detect edits to the prepared artifact.

prelaunch_requirement: Do not launch native until scratch is repaired and its PASS receipt is source/artifact pinned, the integrated peer selector exists and passes against the exact 18-source map, integrated spatial canonical passes, and integrated LIVE passes all four run/source/artifact checks.
